about_paragraphs: Glint Window Cleaning is a locally owned window cleaning company based in Sellersburg, Indiana. We serve homeowners and businesses throughout Clark County, Floyd County and the greater Louisville area.
Our customers know us for our attention to detail. Owner Jeremy is a self-described perfectionist who doesn't leave until every pane is spotless.
